# Professor Aronnax

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Possessing a distinguished reputation in the field of Natural History, this scholar approaches his circumstances with an intense and persistent curiosity. He finds himself compelled to study the wonders of his surroundings, viewing his situation as an opportunity to observe the marvels of modern industry.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P8](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P23](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0023)_

## History

Following his abduction and imprisonment by mysterious captors, Professor Aronnax was held in isolation alongside his companions, [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md). After days of confinement, he was approached by Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), who invited the group to participate in an underwater hunting expedition. Aronnax accepted the invitation and prepared to utilize the Captain's advanced diving technology to explore the submarine environment.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P1](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P4](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P6](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P10](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0010), +50 more_

## Quotes

> “I have no further objections to make,” I answered; “I will only ask you one thing, Captain—how can you light your road at the bottom of the sea?”
>
> — Professor Aronnax — [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P49](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0049)

> "Captain Nemo, to all my objections you make such crushing answers, that I dare no longer doubt. But if I am forced to admit the Rouquayrol and Ruhmkorff apparatus, I must be allowed some reservations with regard to the gun I am to carry."
>
> — Professor Aronnax — [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P51](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0051)

> “Besides,” I added, “to fire under water in a medium eight hundred and fifty-five times denser than the air, we must conquer very considerable resistance.”
>
> — Professor Aronnax — [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P55](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0055)

> "But it seems to me that in this twilight, and in the midst of this fluid, which is very dense compared with the atmosphere, shots could not go far, nor easily prove mortal."
>
> — Professor Aronnax — [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P59](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0059)

> “I will argue no longer,” I replied, rising from the table; “I have nothing left me but to take my gun. At all events, I will go where you go.”
>
> — Professor Aronnax — [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P63](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0063)

## Relationships

### [Captain Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/captain-nemo--professor-aronnax.md)

Professor Aronnax is a captive passenger aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) under the command of Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md). While the Captain maintains control over the Professor's movements, he has begun to integrate him into the life of the ship, such as by inviting him on a hunting expedition at the island of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo). During these interactions, the Captain acts as an instructor, providing the Professor with specialized diving equipment and explaining the advanced technology used by the crew.

- Serves under — captive passenger on the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P19](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P53](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0053), [v1 CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA” P22](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0022), +1 more</sub>

### [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/conseil--professor-aronnax.md)

[Conseil](../character/conseil.md) serves as the dedicated servant to Professor Aronnax, a role he maintains even after their shared abduction and imprisonment on the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). The two share a bond of mutual reliance as they navigate their confinement, often facing the uncertainty of their situation together. [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) remains a constant companion to the Professor, accompanying him through their initial isolation and subsequent excursions into the submarine environment.

- Commands — servant  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P23](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0023)</sub>
- Comrade of — servant and companion on the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P16](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0016)</sub>

### [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/ned-land--professor-aronnax.md)

Professor Aronnax and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) are fellow captives who share the experience of being abducted and held in the iron-walled cabins of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). Their relationship is defined by their mutual status as prisoners, leading them to face the mysterious circumstances of their confinement as a team. They continue to act as comrades while exploring the ship and its surroundings, such as during the hunting expedition at the island of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo).

- Comrade of — fellow traveler and captive  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P23](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0023)</sub>
